review: Inspected the exact final GLB in the browser, including the three-quarter view: clean rounded body, two correct reference-derived eyes, smooth silhouette and no extra features. Final padding matches the body palette. All 54 geometry/UV/skin/animation accessors, nodes and clips are byte/value-identical to the previously reviewed version; the LOD is byte-identical. All-vertex 120Hz checks, 7 neutral/clay/browser views, 35 poses and 10 viewer checks pass.
gameVisualReview: 全5体の最終GLBで元画像の顔と丸い輪郭を確認。ゲームの小さな表示の黒いUV継ぎ目は解消。9人物の左手との接点、飛行、着地、地上での帰還、縦横画面の操作部を実Chromeで確認。再読込は既存タイトルからの参加を別実行で検証し、元のQA待機失敗も保持。
